metadata.title: Bond Yields and Retail Earnings Send Market Reeling

content.text:
CONCLUDED
3 hours ago
A broad stock market slide followed a snap-back in yields. So much for that bond market rebound.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average sank 698 points, or 1.3%. The S&P 500 dropped 0.9%. The Nasdaq Composite fell 1%.
The yield on the 10-year Treasury note rose to nearly 4.7%. The 30-year yield bounced back to 5.24%. Both briefly retreated on Wednesday in the wake of plans by the Treasury Department to increase longer-dated debt buybacks, but the bond market gains were short-lived.
